newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Savings Bank 9-mo profit 38.4 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Savings Bank 9-mo profit 38.4 mln kroons.

text.p: The second largest bank in the Baltic state of Estonia, Estonian Savings Bank, said its nine-month net profit was 38.43 million kroons, versus 27.8 million kroons for the whole of last year.
Total assets after nine months had risen 56 percent to 4.05 billion kroons due to a strong growth in deposits, which rose by 768.9 million kroons, the bank said in a statement.
It said its loan portfolio almost doubled to 1.9 billion kroons and its net interest profit was 135.8 million kroons, a rise of 41.8 percent compared with the first nine months of last year.
